title: Orientation-free comparison from a centred chart to the standard zero-section invariant
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring A, a Noetherian smooth separated quasi-compact map g:V→S with closed section s and a centred chart c as in [def-trf-section-centred-chart-data], construct the following maps of the section invariants of [def-pur-noetherian-section-specialization-arrows]. The source centre satisfies r e=0 and the Rees centre satisfies r_tilde reesCoordinates=0. For a chart e:X→A^d_T with section r sent to zero, toStandard is inverse sectionLocality of [def-trf-section-local-comparison-data], followed by transport along r e=0. sourceMap is the base-change sectionMap followed by open-chart locality and toStandard. familyMap is the identical composite for reesBase, reesOpen and reesCoordinates. standardFibreMap is sectionMap for the Cartesian standard affine-space square along the one section, with zero sections as centres. These are actual specified morphisms, independent of N, Tate objects, normalized affine adjunctions or an orientation choice.

source.place: Local construction, standard affine model, etale Rees maps and restriction at t=1.

proof.text: The commutative Cartesian centre square gives sourceCentre. Apply etale pair-map compatibility to c.e, then the proved standard Rees section equation, to obtain familyCentre. This preserves the coordinate order and holds for d=0.

def sourceMap (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] (d : ℕ) (g : V ⟶ S)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g] [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [HasCompactification g] (s : S ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S) (c : Chart d g s hs) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.b).leftDerivedFunctor.obj (sectionInvariant A g s) ⟶
      sectionInvariant A (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) c.T ↘ c.T)
        (AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) c.T)
